title: The Garden of the Old Mill House
author: Z. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Ivo Blackwood, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
